title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.9.0 publishes the Week 16 educational core: 44 physically checked SU2 8.0.1 teaching-body cases, a portable neural model tested against eight finer CFD references, retained design comparisons, Taylor-Maccoll verification, teaching guides and an executed notebook. Original NASA SEEB-ALR sources and failed reproduction diagnostics remain a deferred research appendix; NASA CFD validation is not claimed. Full Beihang aircraft reproduction, author neural weights, atmospheric propagation and ground PLdB are not claimed.
